pulse.currentFocus: S348 full arc shipped 11 audited improvements: faster Changelog reactions, deterministic evidence, complete 67/67 generator coverage across 80 nodes, closed publisher cascades, and 30 claim/evidence critique packets.
pulse.nextMilestone: Migrate the 30-minute uptime sampler to a Worker scheduled handler plus daily KV drain as a dedicated trust-path release, then close field-vitals freshness with a real cohort.
blockers: Identity/provider acceptance and scoped credential-owner reconciliation remain unresolved independently of this release.
Human signup acceptance, newsletter deployment/arming, Desk cadence, public-member-data, and immutable warm-origin choices remain unobserved or undecided.
Field-vitals freshness requires a genuinely fresh RUM cohort; local lab evidence deliberately abstains.

now: [NEXT][COST/P1] Move the 30-minute uptime sampler off GitHub Actions as a dedicated trust-path migration. Add the Worker `scheduled()` sampler and bounded KV schema, teach the daily job to drain samples into the unchanged public uptime contract, preserve cadence/SLA semantics, and stage/release independently with rollback evidence.

[NEXT][SIL][OBS/P1] Close field-vitals freshness only with real evidence. Surface observed-through/stale-days, obtain a genuinely fresh post-S262 RUM cohort, and bind cohort verdicts to a release SHA so a fresh generated clock can never imply fresh field evidence.

[S348][PERF/P1] Defer Changelog reaction hydration below the fold. DONE S348. Near-viewport observation, bounded four-island idle fallback, layout containment and unavailable-count semantics shipped; focused mutation coverage plus 14/14 inspected theme/device captures bind the deep-scroll reaction state.

[S348][PERF/P2] Make local performance sampling repeatable. DONE S348. The harness warms once, defaults to three measured samples, preserves raw runs, reports full distributions and binds host-noise evidence. The measured Changelog run abstained as volatile (LCP p75 1.636s; CLS median 0.0021); it explicitly makes no field Core Web Vitals claim.

[S348][VERIFY/P1] Make mobile evidence atomic across flaky routes. DONE S348. Process-level retries can no longer restart the single-writer ledger; bounded navigation recovery remains. Clean proof: 215/215 findings, zero failed captures, current candidate/source-bound receipt.

[S348][BUILD/P1] Make generated provenance byte-deterministic. DONE S348. Forge RSS dates now derive from the newest source commit, feedback provenance inherits its source receipt clock, and both builders' `--check` modes compare exact output bytes. Two consecutive rebuilds produced identical hashes; Forge focused coverage is 9/9.

[S348][BUILD/P1] Close evidence-graph coverage instead of carrying a permanent blind spot. DONE S348. Every one of 67 `--check`-gated generators is now source-reviewed and modeled (80 graph nodes total after the critique-packet innovation; unmodeled 33 -> 0). The projection, acyclicity/build-order gate, coverage self-test 12/12, reachability self-test 15/15, and all 80 live check/output contracts pass.

[S348][CI/P1] Close scheduled-publisher cascades exposed by the complete graph. DONE S348. The centralized refresh order now rebuilds all newly visible dependents; both live-data publishers stage every fan-out, including agent discovery, project shards, catalog pages and ledgers. All 29 workflows pass the cascade gate and its widened mutation suite is 21/21.
next: [S348][SIL][NEWS/AI/P1] Claim-evidence relationship map + agent critique packet — DONE. Every Desk story now links to a deterministic `critique.json` argument map joining stable fact receipts, stances, predictions, and hash-bound visual evidence. Unsupported claims stay explicitly `unlinked`; orphan cross-references fail closed; no runtime model call is made.
